case_name: Smt. Jayashree @ Sunita W/O Suresh Sutar vs Shri. Suresh S/O Pandurang Sutar

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Jayashree @ Sunita W/O Suresh Sutar (wife)

facts_of_case: The parties were married in 1999 and had three children. The husband filed for divorce under Section 13(1)(a) and (b) of the Hindu Marriage Act, citing the wife's unreasonable behavior. The trial court granted the petition. This appeal is against that judgment.

legal_principles.principle: A party's failure to obey a court order can lead to the grant of a decree.
legal_principles.held: Inspite of repeated requests made by the husband, she did not return back. Therefore, the husband was constrained to file petition under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act for restitution of conjugal rights.

legal_principles.principle: A delay in filing an appeal can be condoned if a reasonable cause is shown.
legal_principles.held: This Court by accepting the cause shown in the application that she was not residing at the address shown in the cause title of the divorce petition, has condoned the delay.

outcome.final_order: The marriage was dissolved, and the parties were separated.

use_for_drafting: drafting divorce petition under Hindu Marriage Act
appealing against divorce decree in HC
